messages:
Maya: pushed an updated mock for the API Keys screen. two asks: clearer name helper + move revoke out of kebab into a dedicated "danger zone". quick eyes?

Owen: love the danger zone. kebab revoke is invisible. Put a red primary button in the bottom panel labeled 'Permanently revoke key' and a secondary 'Rotate' to the left.

Kai (PM): agreed. also for create modal, add a tiny helper under Name: 'e.g. payments-service-prod' and show a small char counter (max 64). users keep making generic names.

Rae (A11y): character counter should announce remaining chars with aria-live="polite". Name input needs an explicit label and autocomplete="off" to avoid password managers.

Maya: good. for rotate flow: we show the secret once. current copy is long. propose: 'New key generated — copy now. This value is shown only once.' plus a tiny scope pill row.

Owen: also include an overlap checkbox: 'Allow 30 min overlap' with a tooltip explaining tradeoffs. default off. if enabled show both countdown and absolute end time on the key detail.

Rae (A11y): tooltip must use role="tooltip" and be keyboard dismissible. Countdown needs text fallback: 'Overlap ends at 15:42 UTC' and aria-live updates but avoid rapid flashing.

Kai (PM): action items: Maya update figma with danger zone + name helper + compact rotate copy. Rae to post an a11y checklist for these controls. Owen to add tooltip copy.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy scheduled 2026-03-24T17:00Z — includes updated keys UI.

Maya: thanks team, i'll tag when mocks are ready for final review. :thumbsup:
